description: This file defines the SystemCheck class within the OrangeHRM installer utility namespace. It contains numerous system environment checks critical for validating server compatibility during the installation process, such as PHP version, database support, extensions, permissions, and system configuration. The class primarily provides methods for detecting server environment details and compliance with requirements, as well as external dependencies like Doctrine, PDO, and Filesystem.

classes.name: SystemCheck
classes.description: A utility class for performing extensive server environment checks necessary for the deployment of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for verifying server configuration, PHP extensions, database support, file permissions, and system resource allocations, returning structured results for each check.

methods.name: isPHPVersionCompatible
methods.description: Checks if the current PHP version is within the allowed version range as specified in system requirements.

methods.name: isMySqlClientCompatible
methods.description: Validates the installed MySQL client version against minimum recommended version.

methods.name: isMySqlServerCompatible
methods.description: Checks the version of the connected MySQL or MariaDB server for compatibility.

methods.name: isInnoDBSupport
methods.description: Verifies whether InnoDB storage engine is supported and enabled in the database.

methods.name: isWebServerCompatible
methods.description: Detects the web server software details and confirms it is within supported types.

methods.name: isWritableConfigDir
methods.description: Checks if the configuration directory has write permissions.

methods.name: isWritableCacheDir
methods.description: Checks if the cache directory has write permissions.

methods.name: isWritableLogDir
methods.description: Checks if the log directory has write permissions.

methods.name: isWritableCryptoKeyDir
methods.description: Checks if the cryptographic key directory has write permissions.

methods.name: isMaximumSessionIdle
methods.description: Verifies if the PHP session maximum idle time is acceptable for the application.

methods.name: isRegisterGlobalsOff
methods.description: Checks if the deprecated register_globals directive is turned off.

methods.name: getAllocatedMemoryStatus
methods.description: Assesses PHP memory limit configuration and reports status.

methods.name: isCurlEnabled
methods.description: Detects if PHP cURL extension is loaded and enabled.

methods.name: isSimpleXMLEnabled
methods.description: Checks if SimpleXML and related XML extensions are loaded.

methods.name: isZipExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the Zip extension is loaded.

methods.name: isGdExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Verifies if the GD extension is active.

methods.name: isIntlExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks availability of the Intl extension.

methods.name: checkPDOExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Verifies if PDO extension is loaded.

methods.name: checkPDOMySqlExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks for pdo_mysql extension.

methods.name: isLDAPExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if LDAP extension is available.

methods.name: isOpenSSLExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if OpenSSL extension is enabled.

methods.name: checkWritePermission
methods.description: Attempts to write and delete a temporary file to test directory write permissions.

methods.name: checkPhpMemory
methods.description: Determines if the current PHP memory limit meets specified thresholds.

methods.name: getSizeInBytes
methods.description: Converts memory size string (e.g., '128M') to bytes.
